page_title: ATA 2-2 VER | Atalanta v Verona 15/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Juan Luca Sacchi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+4' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) with a great individual effort and attempt from long range. The shot went towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was prepared and managed to keep the ball out. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.

90+1' He should have scored! Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Lorenzo Montipo makes an easy save. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) replaces Fabien Centonze.
90' The referee allows time for a substitution. Michael Folorunsho will be replaced by Diego Coppola (Verona).
88' The corner by Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.

87' A nice pass finds Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the bottom left corner, but Lorenzo Montipo pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him. The ball is out of play. Atalanta win a corner kick.
86' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
83' Daniel Silva (Verona) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
81' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Emil Holm is replaced by Hans Hateboer (Atalanta).
80' Stefan Mitrovic (Verona) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

79' Emil Holm (Atalanta) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
77' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ruben Vinagre (Verona) replacing Tomas Suslov.
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Darko Lazovic as he is replaced by Stefan Mitrovic (Verona).

74' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Lorenzo Montipo makes a great save to stop his effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
72' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is penalised for a foul. Juan Luca Sacchi had a clear view and blows his whistle. A free kick to Verona.
71' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
70' Darko Lazovic (Verona) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
69' The ball is behind the touchline and Verona will take a throw-in.
67' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. Atalanta will take a free kick near the side line.
66' 11:10 – the total goal attempt statistics.
63' A substitution has been made. Rafael Toloi goes off and Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) comes on.
63' Substitution. Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) has come on for Charles De Ketelaere.
63' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Gianluca Scamacca and he is replaced by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta).
63' The ball is out of play. Verona will have a throw-in.
60' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Fabien Centonze plays it into the box, and Tijjani Noslin (Verona) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom right corner. 2:2.
58' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Juan Luca Sacchi signals that the goal stands! The Verona players celebrate.
58' Here comes a substitution. Federico Bonazzoli is given a rest as he is replaced by Karol Swiderski (Verona).
58' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Verona players aren’t happy.

56' 2 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Darko Lazovic (Verona). He perfectly collected a pass from Tijjani Noslin and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:1.
56' The referee blows his whistle as Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) was too aggressive in his challenge. Atalanta get a free kick.
54' Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
52' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Atalanta will take a throw-in.
50' Darko Lazovic (Verona) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
50' Fabien Centonze (Verona) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
47' Juan Cabal (Verona) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Atalanta.
46' The ball has crossed the sideline. Verona are taking a throw-in.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

43' A long pass finds Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies low towards the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo reacts well to make a good save. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
43' Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Juan Cabal (Verona). That's a free kick to Atalanta.
42' Tomas Suslov (Verona) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
40' A corner kick by Verona is thwarted by the well prepared Marco Carnesecchi (Atalanta). The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.

37' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. A free kick has been awarded to Atalanta.
35' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
34' Lorenzo Montipo makes a brilliant save! Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the middle of the goal. Now Atalanta have a corner.

33' What a huge chance for Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
32' Atalanta force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

31' Lorenzo Montipo makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) after a cross from the side. The linesman makes the right call and Atalanta will have a corner.
30' Fabien Centonze (Verona) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Juan Luca Sacchi who sees an offensive foul. Atalanta are awarded a free kick.
29' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) attempts to send a defence-splitting pass in order to find free space for his teammate.
27' Fabien Centonze (Verona) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Atalanta have a free kick.
26' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:2.
23' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) latches onto a short pass from Teun Koopmeiners inside the box, but clips his shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.

22' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
21' Darko Lazovic (Verona) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
18' 2 - 0 It's 2:0! Gianluca Scamacca feeds Ederson (Atalanta) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
16' Fabien Centonze (Verona) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.

13' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Teun Koopmeiners, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta), who beats Lorenzo Montipo with a brilliant shot into the top of the net. 1:0.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
10' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

7' Emil Holm (Atalanta) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Lorenzo Montipo makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
6' It's a throw-in for Atalanta.
5' The players claim that Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Verona have a free kick.
4' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The linesman signals a throw-in for Verona.
3' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
2' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and it's Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Verona have been awarded a free kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Atalanta will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Juan Luca Sacchi.
